collectionunit.notes: Samples for palynological investigation from the ODP 820A core, 5 cm 3 in size, were provided by the Integrated Ocean Drilling Program Core Store at College Station in Texas, USA. Initially 181 samples were taken at approximately 40 cm intervals from the top 67 m and, subsequently, another 70 samples were provided at intervening 20 cm intervals from identified ‘interglacial’ stages to provide greater resolution for these periods.

site.sitedescription:
Near Great Barrier Reef, 40KM from coast, 100KM from Lynch's Crater. Altitudinal Range from sea level to 1600m. Controlled by Easternly Trade Winds, most rainfall in summer. Sensitive to ENSO variability (significantly less rainfall during el nino years).
[...]
Pollen from lowlands to montane rainforest, small patches of auraucarian forest, mangroves, and coastal swamps. Major components of pollen derived from Russel/Mulgrave and Barron rivers.
